help.faq.cycle-record-period.question: Nandika nte imihango yanjye?
help.faq.cycle-record-period.subtitle: Ongeraho amatariki n’igihe imihango yawe imara.
help.faq.cycle-record-period.answer: Mu kalendari cyangwa mu Ikayi ya buri munsi, andika igihe imihango yawe itangiriye, igihe imara n’uko amaraso angana. Aya makuru ni yo yubaka amateka yawe bwite kandi agatuma AWA itanga ibiteganyijwe.
help.faq.cycle-edit-period.question: Nshobora guhindura itariki y’imihango?
help.faq.cycle-edit-period.subtitle: Konga itariki niba ibyo ukurikirana byahindutse.
help.faq.cycle-edit-period.answer: Yego. Hindura itariki ijyanye n’ibyo ukurikirana kugira ngo amateka yawe agumane ukuri ku kwezi kwawe nyako. Ibiteganyijwe bishobora guhinduka hashingiwe ku makuru mashya wabitse.
help.faq.cycle-predictions.question: Imihango yanjye itaha ibarwa ite?
help.faq.cycle-predictions.subtitle: Ibiteganyijwe bishingiye ku mateka yawe bwite.
help.faq.cycle-predictions.answer: AWA iteganya imihango yawe itaha, igihe cyawe cyo gusama na ovulation hashingiwe ku mateka yawe bwite, uburebure bw’ukwezi kwawe n’amakuru wandika. Ibiteganyijwe ntibishingira gusa ku kwezi gusanzwe kw’iminsi 28.
help.faq.cycle-flow.question: Nakurikirana nte ingano y’amaraso?
help.faq.cycle-flow.subtitle: Andika uko amaraso ahinduka.
help.faq.cycle-flow.answer: Koresha Ikayi ya buri munsi wandike ingano y’amaraso y’imihango yawe. Bituma ubika amateka y’uko ihinduka mu mezi atandukanye.
help.faq.cycle-calendar.question: Ibimenyetso byo mu kalendari bisobanura iki?
help.faq.cycle-calendar.subtitle: Imihango, uburumbuke, ovulation na kalendari ya Hijri.
help.faq.cycle-calendar.answer: Kalendari yerekana iminsi y’imihango wanditse hamwe n’igihe giteganyijwe cyo gusama na ovulation. Niba ibimenyetso by’imyemerere byafunguwe, itariki ya Hijri ishobora kwerekanwa iruhande rw’itariki ya Gregori.
help.faq.conceive-fertile-window.questio: Menya nte igihe cyanjye cyo gusama?
help.faq.conceive-fertile-window.subtitl: Reba iminsi giteganyijwe ko ushobora gusama cyane.
help.faq.conceive-fertile-window.answer: Muri uburyo bwo Kugerageza gusama, AWA yerekana igihe giteganyijwe cyo gusama gishingiye ku makuru y’ukwezi kwawe n’amateka yawe bwite.
help.faq.conceive-ovulation.question: Ovulation yanjye iteganywa ite?
help.faq.conceive-ovulation.subtitle: Ibiteganyijwe bihinduka uko ukomeza gukurikirana.
help.faq.conceive-ovulation.answer: Ovulation iteganywa hashingiwe ku makuru ari mu mateka y’ukwezi kwawe. Ibi biteganyijwe bishobora guhinduka uko wongeraho amakuru mashya.
help.faq.conceive-temperature.question: Nshobora gukurikirana ubushyuhe bw’umubiri butuje?
help.faq.conceive-temperature.subtitle: Ongeraho ubushyuhe bwawe mu gukurikirana uburumbuke.
help.faq.conceive-temperature.answer: Yego. Gukurikirana ubushyuhe bw’umubiri butuje ni kimwe mu bigize uburyo bwihariye bwo gusama.
help.faq.conceive-cervical-mucus.questio: Nshobora gukurikirana ururenda rwo mu muhogo w’inda y’umubyeyi?
help.faq.conceive-cervical-mucus.subtitl: Ongeraho iki cyo wabonye mu gukurikirana uburumbuke.
help.faq.conceive-cervical-mucus.answer: Yego. Gukurikirana ururenda rwo mu muhogo w’inda y’umubyeyi ni kimwe mu bimenyetso biboneka mu buryo bwo Kugerageza gusama.
help.faq.conceive-lh-test.question: Nshobora kwandika ikizamini cya LH cya ovulation?
help.faq.conceive-lh-test.subtitle: Bika ibisubizo byawe mu byo ukurikirana.
help.faq.conceive-lh-test.answer: Yego. Kwandika ibizamini bya LH bya ovulation ni kimwe mu bigize urugendo rwo gusama.
help.faq.conceive-intercourse.question: Nandika nte imibonano mpuzabitsina?
help.faq.conceive-intercourse.subtitle: Amakuru bwite mu ikayi yawe.
help.faq.conceive-intercourse.answer: Igice cy’Ubuhehere kigufasha kwandika imibonano mpuzabitsina n’andi makuru bifitanye isano. Iki gice kiguma ari ibanga kandi gishobora kurindwa ukwacyo.
help.faq.contraception-method.question: Ni ubuhe buryo bwo kuboneza urubyaro nshobora gukurikirana?
help.faq.contraception-method.subtitle: Ikinini, impeta, icyomekwa n’imiti ya hormone.
help.faq.contraception-method.answer: AWA ifasha gukurikirana ikinini cyo kuboneza urubyaro, impeta yo mu gitsina, icyomekwa cyo kuboneza urubyaro n’indi miti ya hormone.
help.faq.contraception-pill-reminder.ans: Yego. AWA itanga ibyibutsa wihitiyemo byo kunywa ikinini cyawe, ndetse n’ubutumwa bwa buri munsi.
help.faq.contraception-forgotten-pill.an: Yego. Gukurikirana ibyo wibagiwe kunywa ni kimwe mu bigize urugendo rwo kuboneza urubyaro.
help.faq.contraception-history.question: Amateka y’ibyo nanyweye nyasanga he?
help.faq.contraception-history.subtitle: Subiramo ibyo wanditse n’ibinini wibagiwe.
help.faq.contraception-history.answer: Hari amateka y’ibyo wanyoye agufasha kubika ibyo ukurikirana mu kuboneza urubyaro.
help.faq.contraception-predictions.quest: Ibiteganyijwe biracyafite akamaro iyo ndimo kuboneza urubyaro?
help.faq.contraception-predictions.subti: Uburyo bumwe bushobora guhindura ukwezi kwawe kwa kamere.
help.faq.contraception-predictions.answe: AWA ishobora gukomeza kwerekana amakuru y’ibyo ukurikirana, ariko uko usobanura ibiteganyijwe biterwa n’uko umeze n’uburyo ukoresha. Iyi porogaramu ntisimbura inama z’abaganga.
help.faq.irregular-long-cycle.question: Ukwezi kurekire gufatwa nk’"gutinda"?
help.faq.irregular-long-cycle.subtitle: AWA yita ku mihango idahuye.
help.faq.irregular-long-cycle.answer: Oya. Mu buryo bwa PCOS/Imihango idahuye, AWA ntifata ukwezi kurekire nk’"gutinda" mu buryo bwikora.
help.faq.irregular-symptoms.question: Ni ibihe bimenyetso nshobora gukurikirana nkirwaye PCOS?
help.faq.irregular-symptoms.subtitle: Reba ibimenyetso bihinduka uko igihe gihita.
help.faq.irregular-symptoms.answer: Gukurikirana bikubiyemo imihango idahuye, ibiheri byo mu maso, imbyiro, impinduka z’ibiro n’ibindi bimenyetso bifitanye isano.
help.faq.irregular-acne-hair.question: Nshobora gukurikirana ibiheri n’imbyiro?
help.faq.irregular-acne-hair.subtitle: Ongeraho ibyo wabonye mu gukurikirana PCOS.
help.faq.irregular-acne-hair.answer: Yego. Ibiheri n’imbyiro biri mu bigize gukurikirana bijyanye na PCOS.
help.faq.irregular-weight.question: Nshobora gukurikirana impinduka z’ibiro byanjye?
help.faq.irregular-weight.subtitle: Reba uko ibiro byawe bihinduka uko igihe gihita.
help.faq.irregular-weight.answer: Yego. Gukurikirana ibiro birashoboka mu buryo bwa PCOS/Imihango idahuye.
help.faq.irregular-predictions.question: Kuki ibiteganyijwe byanjye bihinduka cyane?
help.faq.irregular-predictions.subtitle: Imihango idahuye ituma ibiteganyijwe bidahamye.
help.faq.irregular-predictions.answer: Iyo imihango idahuye, ibiteganyijwe bishobora guhinduka cyane mu buryo busanzwe. AWA ikoresha amateka yawe bwite, ntifate ukwezi kurekire nko gutinda mu buryo bwikora.
help.faq.menopause-symptoms.question: Ni ibihe bimenyetso nshobora gukurikirana?
help.faq.menopause-symptoms.subtitle: Gukurikirana bijyanye n’impinduka z’iki gihe cy’ubuzima.
help.faq.menopause-symptoms.answer: Gukurikirana bikubiyemo ubushyuhe bwinshi bwihuta, kubira ibyuya nijoro, ibibazo byo gusinzira, umunaniro, impinduka z’imitekerereze n’ubwenge bwijimye, n’ibindi.
help.faq.menopause-hot-flashes.question: Nshobora kwandika ubushyuhe bwinshi bwihuta?
help.faq.menopause-hot-flashes.subtitle: Reba uko bubaho kenshi uko igihe gihita.
help.faq.menopause-hot-flashes.answer: Yego. Ubushyuhe bwinshi bwihuta ni kimwe mu bimenyetso biboneka mu buryo bwa Mbere yo gucura/Gucura.
help.faq.menopause-sleep.question: Nshobora gukurikirana ibitotsi n’umunaniro?
help.faq.menopause-sleep.subtitle: Reba ibibazo byo gusinzira n’umunaniro.
help.faq.menopause-sleep.answer: Yego. Ibibazo byo gusinzira, kubira ibyuya nijoro n’umunaniro byose biboneka muri uru rugendo.
help.faq.menopause-hormonal-treatment.su: Bika amakuru afitiye akamaro ibyo ukurikirana.
help.faq.menopause-hormonal-treatment.an: Yego. Ushobora gukurikirana ubuvuzi bwa hormone muri ubu buryo.
help.faq.menopause-labs.question: Nshobora kwandika ibisubizo bya FSH na estradiol?
help.faq.menopause-labs.subtitle: Ongeraho bimwe mu bisubizo by’ibizamini bya laboratwari.
help.faq.menopause-labs.answer: Yego. Ibisubizo by’ibizamini bya laboratwari nka FSH na estradiol bishobora kwandikwa muri ubu buryo.
help.faq.pregnancy-due-date.question: Itariki yo kubyara ibarwa ite?
help.faq.pregnancy-due-date.subtitle: Igereranyo cyerekanwa mu gukurikirana inda.
help.faq.pregnancy-due-date.answer: Gukurikirana inda bibara itariki yawe iteganyijwe yo kubyara hashingiwe ku makuru ari mu byo ukurikirana.
help.faq.pregnancy-weekly.question: Nshobora gukurikirana inda yanjye icyumweru ku cyumweru?
help.faq.pregnancy-weekly.subtitle: Reba uko inda yawe ikura buri cyumweru.
help.faq.pregnancy-weekly.answer: Yego. AWA itanga gukurikirana buri cyumweru kandi yerekana uko inda yawe igenda ikura.
help.faq.pregnancy-appointments.question: Nshobora kwandika gahunda zanjye zo kwa muganga?
help.faq.pregnancy-appointments.subtitle: Bika gahunda zawe z’ingenzi ahantu hamwe.
help.faq.pregnancy-appointments.answer: Yego. Gahunda zo kwa muganga n’ibizamini by’ingenzi biri mu bigize gukurikirana inda.
help.faq.pregnancy-reminders.question: Nshobora kubona ibyibutsa by’ibizamini byanjye?
help.faq.pregnancy-reminders.subtitle: Shyiraho ibyibutsa byihariye.
help.faq.pregnancy-reminders.answer: Yego. Ibyibutsa byihariye bya gahunda n’ibizamini by’ingenzi birahari.
help.faq.pregnancy-journal.question: Ni iki nshobora gukurikirana mu gihe ntwite?
help.faq.pregnancy-journal.subtitle: Ibimenyetso, ibiro, imitekerereze, ibitotsi n’amakuru bwite.
help.faq.pregnancy-journal.answer: Gukurikirana inda bishobora gukubiyemo ibimenyetso wumva, ibiro, imitekerereze, ibitotsi n’amakuru bwite y’ubuvuzi.
help.faq.postpartum-lochia.question: Nakurikirana nte lochia?
help.faq.postpartum-lochia.subtitle: Reba igihe imara n’uko ibisohoka bihinduka.
help.faq.postpartum-lochia.answer: Gukurikirana nyuma yo kubyara bikubiyemo igihe lochia imara, uko amaraso ahinduka n’ibimenyetso bifitanye isano.
help.faq.postpartum-cycle-return.subtitl: Reba ukwezi kwawe gusubira buhoro buhoro.
help.faq.postpartum-cycle-return.answer: AWA ikurikirana isubira ry’ukwezi kwawe, isubukura ry’imihango n’impinduka za hormone nyuma yo kubyara.
help.faq.postpartum-breastfeeding.questi: Nshobora gukurikirana konsa n’imihango ihagaze kubera konsa?
help.faq.postpartum-breastfeeding.subtit: Bika aya makuru mu rugendo rwawe rwo nyuma yo kubyara.
help.faq.postpartum-breastfeeding.answer: Yego. Konsa n’imihango ihagaze nyuma yo kubyara biri mu byo gukurikirana bihari.
help.faq.postpartum-recovery.question: Ni iki nshobora gukurikirana mu gihe ngarura imbaraga?
help.faq.postpartum-recovery.subtitle: Umunaniro, ibitotsi, imitekerereze, ububabare no gukira kw’umubiri.
help.faq.postpartum-recovery.answer: Gukurikirana buri munsi nyuma yo kubyara bikubiyemo umunaniro, ibitotsi, imitekerereze, ububabare no gukira kw’umubiri, n’ibindi.
help.faq.postpartum-nifas.question: AWA yita ite kuri nifas?
help.faq.postpartum-nifas.subtitle: Ikimenyetso cy’imyemerere, gitandukanye no gukurikirana k’ubuvuzi.
help.faq.postpartum-nifas.answer: Iyo ibimenyetso by’imyemerere byafunguwe, AWA ishobora gukurikirana igihe amaraso yo nyuma yo kubyara amara no kwerekana itariki ya nifas hakurikijwe imyemerere wahisemo. Igihe ntarengwa gishobora gutandukana hagati y’amashuri y’ibitekerezo kandi ntikigaragazwa nk’ukuri kumwe kuri bose aho ibitekerezo bitandukanye.
help.faq.loss-bleeding.question: Nakurikirana nte amaraso?
help.faq.loss-bleeding.subtitle: Reba uko ahinduka, nta kwihutira gusubira mu gukurikirana bisanzwe.
help.faq.loss-bleeding.answer: Urugendo rwo Nyuma yo gukurizamo inda rukurikirana amaraso n’uko ahinduka, mu mwanya uhuye n’iki gihe.
help.faq.loss-cycle-return.question: Nakurikirana nte isubira ry’ukwezi kwanjye?
help.faq.loss-cycle-return.subtitle: Subukura gukurikirana ku muvuduko wawe.
help.faq.loss-cycle-return.answer: AWA ikurikirana isubira ry’ukwezi kwawe nyuma yo gukurizamo inda, igufasha gusubukura amateka yawe buhoro buhoro nta guhatirwa gukurikirana imihango bisanzwe ako kanya.
help.faq.loss-symptoms.question: Ni ibihe bimenyetso nshobora kwandika?
help.faq.loss-symptoms.subtitle: Kurikirana ibimenyetso by’umubiri ushaka kwandika.
help.faq.loss-symptoms.answer: Gukurikirana ibimenyetso by’umubiri birahari muri uru rugendo.
help.faq.loss-notes.question: Nshobora kubika inyandiko bwite?
help.faq.loss-notes.subtitle: Umwanya bwite mu ikayi yawe.
help.faq.loss-notes.answer: Yego. Inyandiko bwite zirahari kugira ngo zigufashe muri iki gihe.
help.faq.loss-conceive-again.question: Nshobora gusubira mu kugerageza gusama nyuma?
help.faq.loss-conceive-again.subtitle: Hindura intego yawe igihe cyose wifuza kongera kugerageza.
help.faq.loss-conceive-again.answer: Ubufasha bwo gusubukura kugerageza gusama burimo. Guhindura intego yawe bikorwa buhoro buhoro kandi buri gihe ni icyemezo cyawe.
help.faq.spiritual-hijri.question: Kalendari ya Hijri ikora ite?
help.faq.spiritual-hijri.subtitle: Yerekana itariki ya Hijri iruhande rw’itariki ya Gregori.
help.faq.spiritual-hijri.answer: Iyo ibimenyetso by’imyemerere byafunguwe, AWA ishobora kwerekana itariki ya Hijri iruhande rw’itariki ya Gregori no kugaragaza amezi y’ingenzi nka Ramadan cyangwa Dhul Hijjah.
help.faq.spiritual-purity.question: Imimerere y’isuku y’imyemerere isobanura iki?
help.faq.spiritual-purity.subtitle: Ikimenyetso cy’ibanga gifitanye isano no gusubukura ibikorwa by’imyemerere.
help.faq.spiritual-purity.answer: AWA ishobora kwerekana ikimenyetso cy’ibanga gitandukanya imihango yawe n’igihe cyawe cy’isuku (tuhr) iyo ibimenyetso by’imyemerere byafunguwe.
help.faq.spiritual-prayer-return.questio: AWA yerekana ite igihe isengesho risubukurwa?
help.faq.spiritual-prayer-return.subtitl: Ikimenyetso gishingiye ku gihe imihango yawe irangiriye.
help.faq.spiritual-prayer-return.answer: Niba isuku isubiye mbere y’uko igihe cy’isengesho gihari kirangira, porogaramu ishobora kugaragaza ko iryo sengesho rigombwa kongera gusengwa. Amasengesho wasimbutse mu gihe cy’imihango ntabarwa nk’ayo kwishyura.
help.faq.spiritual-qadaa.question: Gukurikirana ibisibo byo kwishyura bikora bite?
help.faq.spiritual-qadaa.subtitle: Ibara iminsi wasimbutse kubera imihango.
help.faq.spiritual-qadaa.answer: AWA ishobora gutanga ikibarura cy’iminsi y’igisibo wasimbutse kubera imihango, cyane cyane mu gihe cya Ramadan, hamwe n’icyibutsa cyoroheje nyuma y’ukwezi cyo gutegura kuyishyura.
help.faq.spiritual-nifas.question: Nifas yerekanwa ite?
help.faq.spiritual-nifas.subtitle: Ikimenyetso gishobora gutandukana hagati y’amashuri y’ibitekerezo.
help.faq.spiritual-nifas.answer: AWA ishobora kwerekana imyemerere wahisemo ku gihe ntarengwa cya nifas, igaragaza itandukaniro riri hagati y’amashuri aho ibikubiye mu byemejwe bibivuga. Porogaramu ntigaragaza umubare umwe nk’ukuri ntakuka.
help.faq.spiritual-istihada.question: AWA itanga inama kuri istihada?
help.faq.spiritual-istihada.subtitle: Ibisobanuro by’inyigisho, ntabwo ari fatwa yihariye.
help.faq.spiritual-istihada.answer: AWA ishobora gutanga ibisobanuro rusange by’inyigisho kuri istihada n’icyo bisobanuye ku bikorwa by’imyemerere. Porogaramu ntitanga fatwa yihariye, kandi ibikubiye mu by’imyemerere biba bigomba kwemezwa n’inzego zizwi.
help.faq.journal-what-can-track.question: Ni iki nshobora kwandika mu ikayi yanjye?
help.faq.journal-what-can-track.subtitle: Ibimenyetso, imitekerereze, ubuhehere, ibitotsi n’imyitozo.
help.faq.journal-what-can-track.answer: Ikayi ya buri munsi ikubiyemo ibimenyetso by’umubiri, imitekerereze, ubuhehere, ibitotsi, imyitozo ngororamubiri n’inyandiko bwite.
help.faq.journal-what-can-track.subtitle: Ibimenyetso, imitekerereze, ibitotsi, imyitozo, kunywa amazi, amaraso y’imihango n’inyandiko.
help.faq.journal-what-can-track.answerDa: Ikayi ya buri munsi igufasha gukurikirana ibimenyetso by’umubiri, imitekerereze, ibitotsi, imyitozo ngororamubiri, kunywa amazi, amaraso y’imihango n’inyandiko bwite.
help.faq.journal-intimacy.question: Igice cyanjye cy’Ubuhehere gishobora kurindwa?
help.faq.journal-intimacy.subtitle: Igice cy’ibanga, gitandukanye.
help.faq.journal-intimacy.answer: Yego. Igice cy’Ubuhehere gishobora guhishwa no kurindwa na PIN cyangwa Face ID byacyo bitandukanye.
